home.description: Multi-speciality hospital at Jindal Chowk, Hisar, Haryana — emergency care, surgery, orthopaedics, obstetrics and gynaecology, with diagnostics, imaging and pathology on the same campus.
home.servicesIntro: Grouped by how you get to them: departments you consult or are admitted under, tests and scans you are referred for, and the services that run alongside your treatment.
home.rosterNote: Consultant profiles are published as LIMS supplies them. For a department not listed here, please contact the hospital.
home.restOfSiteIntro: Departments, diagnostics, patient services and the consultant roster are above. These are the remaining sections in the main menu.

doctorProfile.urgentCareBody: The emergency line goes straight to the hospital, no appointment needed.

serviceDetail.aboutServiceFallback: An overview, the conditions treated and the procedures offered are published from information supplied by LIMS. Until the hospital provides them, this page does not describe what happens here rather than guess.
serviceDetail.morePendingHeading: More detail is on its way
serviceDetail.morePendingBody: This page will grow to include the department's own highlights, sub-specialties, the consultant team's approach, equipment and technology, and patient experiences — published once LIMS supplies them, not invented here in the meantime.

awaitingContent.defaultBody: This section is published from information supplied by LIMS and is not yet available. For anything urgent, please call the hospital directly.

healthPackagesPage.title: Health check packages
healthPackagesPage.intro: Preventive health checks bundled as fixed packages.
healthPackagesPage.awaitingBody: LIMS has not yet supplied the package list or its pricing. Rather than publish indicative prices the hospital never quoted, this page waits for the real ones — please call to ask what is available.
healthPackagesPage.bookableHeading: The tests themselves are already bookable
healthPackagesPage.bookableBody: While the bundled package list is still coming, {count, plural, one {# individual diagnostics and imaging service is} other {# individual diagnostics and imaging services are}} already published — book one directly, or call to ask what a package would cover.

insurancePage.title: Insurance & billing
insurancePage.intro: Cashless claims, reimbursement and what to bring to the billing desk.
insurancePage.awaitingBody: The list of insurers and third-party administrators LIMS accepts is not published here yet. Please confirm your cover with the hospital before admission — an insurer named on a website that turns out not to be empanelled becomes a bill at the desk.
insurancePage.askBillingBody: The hospital can confirm whether your policy is accepted and what a cashless claim needs.

visitorsPage.title: Visitor information
visitorsPage.intro: Visiting a patient, ward access and where to come.
visitorsPage.awaitingBody: Visiting hours, attendant passes and ICU access rules are set by the hospital and vary by ward. They are not published here yet — please call before travelling rather than relying on a general figure.

contactPage.title: Contact LIMS Hisar
contactPage.intro: Both published hospital numbers, and where to find us.
contactPage.noHoursNote: No opening hours are published here yet. Rather than state hours LIMS has not confirmed, this page gives you the numbers — please call to check before travelling.
contactPage.bookingBody: You can send a callback request online and the hospital will ring you to confirm a time.
